summary.text: Chip Fitzpatrick, who appears on Ballotpedia as Sidney Fitzpatrick, is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 42 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Jeremiah Jabs.
His career includes work for his local sheriff's department, service as an elder support advocate and membership on the Big Horn County Commission.

paragraphs.text: Fitzpatrick's career includes working for his local sheriff's department, serving as an elder support advocate, and serving as a member of the Big Horn County Commission.
He previously served in the Crow Tribal Legislature.
Fitzpatrick took office in the Montana House in January 2025 and was assigned to the Fish, Wildlife and Parks, Transportation and Business and Labor committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
